shopAvailability.festivalSeasons: The shop is open during all festive seasons and on festival days, except on the day of Diwali.

returnsAndExchange.excludedReason: Inner wears cannot be returned or exchanged.
returnsAndExchange.conditions: The product must be returned as it is, without any stains or damage, and in almost the same packaging as it was sold.

delivery.festiveNote: Delivery timings may vary during festive seasons.
delivery.shippingChargesNote: Shipping charges depend on the delivery area and will be updated soon.

paymentMethods.summary: We accept UPI (GPay, PhonePe), Credit/Debit Cards, Cash, and Net Banking for both in-store shopping and online orders.
